# Justin He

> Portfolio and personal website of Justin He

## Blog

- [Leaving Tech Job for New Ventures](https://www.justinhe.com/blog/creating-a-home-on-the-internet): Personal essay about quitting corporate tech job to pursue entrepreneurial ambitions and life experiences.

## Other

- [Claude Surf Development Orchestrator](https://www.justinhe.com/projects/project-claude-surf): AI-powered tool orchestrating autonomous software development with Claude, integrating Linear tickets and Git workflows.
- [Color Theory Fundamentals](https://www.justinhe.com/a): Practice guide covering color wheels, dimensions, harmony schemes, and perceptual color spaces.
- [History of Martian Ideas](https://www.justinhe.com/b): Two centuries of human imagination about Martians, from canals to invasion novels to actual spacecraft discoveries.
- [The Shipping Container](https://www.justinhe.com/c): How standardized steel containers revolutionized global trade and enabled modern globalization economics.
- [Sourdough Science and Practice](https://www.justinhe.com/d): Detailed guide to sourdough starter microbiology, fermentation chemistry, and bread baking techniques.
- [Ancient Eclipse Predicting Device](https://www.justinhe.com/e): Ancient Greek geared calculator that predicted eclipses using sophisticated mechanical astronomy from antiquity.
- [Songbird Vocal Learning Mechanisms](https://www.justinhe.com/f): Songbirds learn vocalizations through sensory and sensorimotor phases, requiring auditory feedback and critical developmental periods.
- [Map Projections Explained](https://www.justinhe.com/g): Explores why flat maps distort Earth, historical projections like Mercator, and Web Mercator's ubiquitous use online.
- [Bioluminescence Chemistry and Biology](https://www.justinhe.com/h): Explores cold light chemistry, deep-sea camouflage, and how glowing jellyfish revolutionized biology research.
- [Pokémon's Origins and Development](https://www.justinhe.com/x): How a Tokyo boy's insect collecting inspired the world's highest-grossing media franchise through six years of development.
- [Competitive Pokémon Metagame](https://www.justinhe.com/y): How players built a competitive ruleset for Pokémon's hidden mechanics and deterministic combat system.
- [Pokémon Red Blue Generation One Glitches](https://www.justinhe.com/z): Exploration of famous bugs that shaped Pokémon Red and Blue including MissingNo., the unreachable truck, and the Mew glitch.
